text:
Priya K: heads up — CI job `audit-event-conformance` is failing on master, several golden fixture diffs. Looks like failures started after merge of #4021 (RBAC field reshape).
Omar S: can you paste the failing assertion / logs?
Priya K: log snippet: ```FAIL: serialize_spec (goldens/audit/keystore.rotate_key.json) AssertionError: missing required field 'actor.id' but found null -> payload: {
  "event": "keystore.rotate_key",
  "actor": null,
  "meta": {...}
}```
Emma L: hmmm. We rolled a KMS redaction change in #3987 that now nulls out the actor object instead of leaving a placeholder with `redacted:true`. That would break the validator expecting an object with id.
Ian M: if that's true, two options: update golden fixtures to the new shape, or make the schema validator accept `actor: null` as a redaction signal and normalize to `{id: null, redacted: true}` during CI validation.
Priya K: we can't ship a shape change that removes `actor.id` for customers; audit UI and downstream compliance hooks depend on it. Need compatibility: validator should accept both, but we should mark the change and notify customers.
Emma L: agree. Short-term: change validator normalization layer so CI passes, but also add a strict gate that detects customer-visible changes (actor.id removed entirely) and flags a manual review.
Omar S: I'll triage which endpoints' fixtures are impacted. Off the top of my head: `keystore.rotate_key`, `auth.assign_role`, `kms.encrypt`, `session.force_logout`.
Priya K: adding to that: `audit.log_export` and `rbac.role_update`.
Ian M: proposed validator patch (local quickfix): ```diff
- if event['actor'] is None: fail
+ if event['actor'] is None: event['actor'] = {"id": null, "redacted": true}
```
Ian M: also adding a canary test that compares rendered, customer-visible fields before/after normalization and fails if any are dropped.
Priya K: good. Omar — can you own golden fixture updates + a changelog entry? We need to capture which golden changes are permissible vs. require customer notice.
Omar S: on it. I'll open a PR updating the affected goldens and add a `golden-notes.md` in the test harness to enumerate allowed redaction conversions.
build-bot: Re-run requested by <@Omar S>. Job `audit-event-conformance-ci#1172` queued.
security-bot: FYI — see runbook https://redwood.internal/runbooks/audit-schema-change for incident classification and customer notification steps.
Emma L: can we add a CI diff that fails only on changes to `actor.id`, `event`, `timestamp`, and `resource.*`? rest can be tolerated for redaction semantics.
Ian M: yes — implement `scripts/diff_goldens.py --strict-fields actor.id,event,timestamp,resource.*` for the gate.
Priya K: timeline: Omar to open PR w/ golden updates + notes today, Ian to push validator normalization patch & strict-diff gate, Emma to update runbook bullet about KMS redaction behavior, I'll draft customer-facing note if required.
Omar S: PR in progress, tagging you all. :thumbsup:
Priya K: thanks — ping here when CI green or if further regressions crop up.
build-bot: Job `audit-event-conformance-ci#1172` started — running tests (this may take ~8m).
security-bot: added incident label `schema-regression` to thread for tracking.
Emma L: if CI rediffs show non-redaction field churn, we should block the merge.
Ian M: acknowledged. Local test command if anyone wants to reproduce: `./scripts/validate_audit_event.py --goldens samples/goldens --normalize-redactions`
Priya K: closing loop: keep thread updated with PR links and CI runs. Thanks all.
